name: fleet
description: Parallel multi-session Claude orchestration with hierarchical authorization, depth-aware delegation, and tool-level event observability. Spawn agents on tickets, watch a dashboard, get notified when reviews land or merges happen.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel multi-session Claude orchestration with hierarchical authorization, depth-aware delegation, and tool-level event observability.
interface.longDescription: Parallel multi-session Claude orchestration with hierarchical authorization, depth-aware delegation, and tool-level event observability. Spawn agents on tickets, watch a dashboard, get notified when reviews land or merges happen.
defaultPrompt: Dependency-aware multi-stage orchestration of parallel sessions.
Find sessions in the multi-session command center whose PRs have already merged on GitHub, and kill+cleanup each (with confirmation).
Spawn a dedicated reviewer session for a given session's open PR.

Install thin wrappers in ~/.local/bin/ so the fleet plugin's public CLIs (claude-sessions, claude-sessions-web, spawn-claude-feature) are callable from the user's interactive zsh / bash, not just from
Spawn one or many parallel Claude agents on Jira tickets, with full-auto mode and Jira-aware prompt construction.
Chat-friendly snapshot of the multi-session Claude command center.
Spawn N variant agents on the same Jira ticket, each with a different strategy hint, then auto-spawn a judge that reads all the resulting PRs and merges the best one.
Block until one or more sessions reach a target state (default done).
